idea-plugin.name: CheckoutAndBuild
idea-plugin.description:
Local one-click CI inside your IDE: keep any number of projects up to date with a single click — git pull, install/restore, build and test, all out of process and in parallel.

Detects .NET solutions, Gradle, Maven, npm, Composer, Cargo and Go projects beneath your working folders. Same-priority projects run in parallel; priority groups run in order.

Works in every JetBrains IDE. The big brother for Visual Studio is on the Visual Studio Marketplace.
